segments.text: I finished my part of the feature by Tuesday.
segments.englishExplanation: The speaker completed their assigned part of the software feature by Tuesday.
segments.turkishExplanation: Konuşmacı, özelliğin kendisine düşen kısmını Salı gününe kadar bitirdi.

segments.text: But I couldn't test it, the other team's API still wasn't live.
segments.englishExplanation: They could not test their work because the API built by another team was not ready yet.
segments.turkishExplanation: Ancak test edemedi çünkü diğer ekibin API'si henüz yayında değildi.

segments.text: My manager asked why the ticket was still open.
segments.englishExplanation: The manager inquired why the assigned task was still marked as open.
segments.turkishExplanation: Yöneticisi, görevin (biletin) neden hâlâ açık olduğunu sordu.

segments.text: I said, I'm blocked by another team's endpoint.
segments.englishExplanation: The speaker explained that they are unable to proceed until another team's API endpoint is ready.
segments.turkishExplanation: Konuşmacı, diğer ekibin uç noktası (endpoint) tamamlanmadığı için ilerleyemediğini söyledi.

segments.text: As soon as it's deployed, I can finish the integration.
segments.englishExplanation: The integration work can be finished as soon as the external service goes live.
segments.turkishExplanation: Sistem canlıya alınır alınmaz entegrasyonu tamamlayabileceğini belirtti.

segments.englishExplanation: The manager nodded his head to acknowledge the explanation.
segments.turkishExplanation: Yöneticisi anladığını göstermek için başını salladı.

segments.englishExplanation: A conversational phrase meaning that something is logical or understandable.
segments.turkishExplanation: Söylenen şeyin mantıklı ve anlaşılır olduğunu belirten kısa bir ifade.

segments.englishExplanation: The manager offered to help if there was anything he could do.
segments.turkishExplanation: Yöneticisi yapabileceği bir yardım olup olmadığını sordu.

segments.englishExplanation: A simple response indicating that no help is needed right now.
segments.turkishExplanation: Şu an için gerekmediğini belirten kısa ve doğal bir yanıt.

segments.text: There's not much I can do until then.
segments.englishExplanation: The speaker explains that they cannot take further action until the dependency is resolved.
segments.turkishExplanation: Konuşmacı, o zamana kadar kendisinin yapabileceği pek bir şey olmadığını açıkladı.

segments.text: So I opened a different ticket.
segments.englishExplanation: Because of the delay, the speaker picked up another task ticket to work on.
segments.turkishExplanation: Bu yüzden farklı bir görev kaydı açıp ona başladı.

segments.englishExplanation: A lighthearted statement observing that waiting for external tasks is still a normal part of working.
segments.turkishExplanation: Beklemenin de iş sürecinin doğal bir parçası olduğunu belirten esprili bir kapanış.

learningPoints.englishExplanation: In work and project management contexts, 'blocked by' means being unable to move forward on a task because you are waiting for another team or prerequisite to be finished.
learningPoints.turkishExplanation: İş ve proje süreçlerinde 'blocked by' olmak, harici bir bağımlılık veya başka bir ekibin işi tamamlanmadığı için kendi işine devam edememek anlamına gelir.
learningPoints.exampleEn: We are currently blocked by the legal team's review.
learningPoints.exampleTr: Şu anda hukuk ekibinin incelemesini beklediğimiz için ilerleyemiyoruz.

learningPoints.englishExplanation: A common informal expression used to indicate that an explanation or statement is reasonable and clear.
learningPoints.turkishExplanation: Bir açıklama veya durumun mantıklı, makul ve anlaşılır olduğunu belirtmek için kullanılan yaygın bir günlük ifade.
learningPoints.exampleEn: The train was delayed, so I took the bus. — Makes sense.
learningPoints.exampleTr: Tren gecikti, ben de otobüse bindim. — Mantıklı.

quiz.question: In the video, what does the speaker mean by saying "I'm blocked by another team's endpoint"?

options.text: They cannot continue their work because they depend on another team's API to be ready first.
They are unable to write code because their server access was temporarily revoked.
They canceled the ticket because the other team decided not to build the feature.
They finished the integration but were asked not to test it until next week.

issues.message: Segment 7 çok kısa/trivial ("Makes sense.") ama bir learning point üretilmiş.
